# sh-fpv-requests-card

**Purpose:** One request from her, with its action.

**Switches:** Type = what she asked for.

**Rules:** the Birth details card shows only to a viewer who hasn’t added his.

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 4 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2877-20530) (node `2877:20530`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### Type=Message

**When:** she sent a message. Reply.

### Type=Photo

**When:** she asked for the viewer’s photo. Add photo.

### Type=Birth details

**When:** she asked for birth details and the viewer hasn’t added his. Add details.

### Type=Message · free viewer

**Purpose:** her message request for a free (or gamified) viewer — the message is masked after its first words; Upgrade Now opens the premium plans page.
